shared_elements: bearded male figures with patterned/curled hair and beards
figures wearing patterned garments with fringe
low relief carving with incised surface detail
architectural/decorative patterning rendered as repeated blocks or hatching
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with curled hair and beards, patterned fringed garments, and outstretched arms holding objects, rendered in the same low-relief convention with incised linear infill for hair, textiles and masonry — a distinctive shared set of conventions. However, A shows a single large winged genie standing with raised hand and bucket-like vessel filling the panel, while B is a small-scale multi-figure narrative of archers and a siege engine attacking a towered, gated fortification, so the compositions and the relationships between figures are quite different.
